crossRefs.note: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.
When he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,
Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.
Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples, and a great multitude followed him from Galilee, from Judea,
When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, “Where did…
He came down with them, and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples, and a great number of the people…
All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out of him and healed them all.
He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.
Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the sea of Galilee, through the middle of the region…

people.name: Decapolis
people.line: A group of ten Hellenistic cities in ancient Palestine.

people.name: Galilee
people.line: Region in northern Israel; key location in Jesus' ministry

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

people.name: Judea
people.line: The southern region of Israel, centered around Jerusalem

translations.web: Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea and from beyond the Jordan followed him.
translations.bsb: Large crowds followed Him, having come from Galilee, the Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and beyond the Jordan.
translations.kjv: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Jerusalem, and from Judaea, and from beyond Jordan.
translations.asv: And there followed him great multitudes from Galilee and Decapolis and Jerusalem and Judaea and from beyond the Jordan.
